title: Arbitration Counter Overflow — Wrong Bit Width
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [FAIRNESS] Counter overflow at cycle 255; early re-arbitration detected
rtl: logic [7:0] count;  // Max 255 — insufficient for 300-cycle fairness window
expected_root_cause: The fairness window counter is declared as logic [7:0], limiting it to 255 cycles; the required window is 300 cycles, so the counter overflows at cycle 255, wraps to zero, and triggers a premature re-arbitration event.
fix_replacement: logic [8:0] count;  // 9 bits required for window up to 511 cycles
description: The fairness window counter is 8 bits (max 255) but the required fairness window is 300 cycles; at cycle 255 the counter wraps to zero and grants master 0 prematurely.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [FAIRNESS] Counter overflow at cycle 255; early re-arbitration detected
success_log: Counter reaches 300 without overflow. Fairness window met exactly.
